scientific_integrity: All almost-sure and weak-convergence assertions are proved mathematically with standard martingale, SLLN and CLT arguments; finite diagnostics are not used as infinite-time proof. The motivating pair and its standard-lift rotation number are credited to its authors.
scientific_limitations: Results specific to the two Arnold generators in Li–Lloyd Example 8, with iid Bernoulli symbols of fixed probabilities in (0,1).
The unbiased random exceptional initial threshold is not classified dynamically.
The central limit theorem concerns reciprocal endpoint distance for biased signs only, not arbitrary correlated driving.
Bibliographic priority requires independent checking against broader stochastic-interval dynamics.
title: A uniform random basin separator and sharp parabolic clocks for a Bernoulli Arnold pair
